newsitem.title: CHILE: Santander says it made big stride in Chile tender.
newsitem.headline: Santander says it made big stride in Chile tender.

text.p: Santander Investment, acting on behalf of Spanish utility Empresa Nacional de Electricidad SA (Endesa-Espana), said it had made a big stride in the first day of a tender to buy shares in a group of Chilean investment firms.

Santander said it had fielded offers on Monday from sellers representing 12 percent of the stock in the so-called Chispas investment firms, which control a major stake in utility holding company Enersis SA.

By company, the offers received were for 7.28 percent in Luz, 13.18 percent in Luz y Fuerza, 13.91 in Los Almendros, 13.27 percent in Chispa Uno and 13.21 percent in Chispa Dos, the Spanish investment bank said in a press release.
The tender, dubbed the deal of the century by the local press, is due to close on August 30.

If it succeeds in its $1.5 billion bid, Endesa-Espana would also gain control of Chilean power generator Empresa Nacional de Electricidad SA (Chile and electricity distributor Chilectra SA, in which Enersis has major stakes.
